Secara Fisik Di Cyber 2 Tower Lantai 26

Secara Fisik DI Cyber 2 Tower, Lantai 26, JL. H. R. Rasuna Said Blok X-5 No.13, Jakarta Selatan, 12950 DAN Secara Elektronik Melalui Aplikasi Yang Disediakan Oleh PT Kustodian Sentralefek Indonesia, Yaitu Electronic General Meeting System Ksei Kota Adm. Jakartaselatan Dki. Jaka
agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and ratified the audited financial statements, granting a full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the allocation of US$760,179,521 in net profit, designating US$450 million for dividends, US$10 million for mandatory reserves, and US$300,179,521 for retained earnings.
Agenda #3: The assembly reappointed KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto dan Rekan (PwC) and Firman Sababalat to audit the company's 2026 consolidated financial statements.
Agenda #4: Authority was granted to the Board of Commissioners to determine the salaries, honorarium, and allowances for both the Board of Commissioners and Directors for the 2026 fiscal year.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved a share buyback program with a maximum budget of Rp5,000,000,000,000 and authorized the Board of Directors to execute the program's timing and volume.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved adjusting Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align the company's business activities with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI).
Agenda #7: This agenda item served as a formal report to shareholders regarding the realization of the use of proceeds from the company's Initial Public Offering, requiring no formal voting.
Agenda #8: The company defined its leadership structure for the 2024-2029 period, appointing Julius Aslan as President Director and Budi Bowoleksono as President Commissioner.
